cohort: 146,458 Hispanic and 104,399 non-Hispanic White women who gave birth in Texas in 2009
finding: Hispanic women had an increased risk of inadequate gestational weight gain and a decreased risk of excessive gestational weight gain compared to non-Hispanic White women, while border-residing Hispanic women had the highest risk of cesarean birth.
mod_finding: Border-residing Hispanic women were at greater risk of cesarean birth than other women.
